prompt:
Write a WhatsApp group chat export in English for a fictional UPI-fraud training case.
Group members (use exactly these names as senders): Pooja R., Pranab ji, Pooja ji, Raju ji.
The chat covers 18/03/26, 6:45 pm to 18/03/26, 8:45 pm. It must have exactly 29 message lines, in time order.
Line format, one message per line, nothing else:
DD/MM/YY, h:mm am - Sender: message text
These messages must appear word for word, in this order, with these exact timestamps and senders:
18/03/26, 7:38 pm - Pooja ji: Pranab ji, delete the transfer record right now
Fill the other lines with ordinary conversation. Do not add a header or explanations.
Fix these problems from your previous attempt:
- chat.txt:21 matches the instruction phrase but is not the instruction line
- F1: chat.txt:14 at 7:28 pm vs calls.csv row 3 at 19:37 differs by 9 min (tolerance 2)
- Q2: solver answered UNSOLVABLE, key is 2026-03-18T19:38:00+05:30
text:
18/03/26, 6:45 pm - Pooja R.: Good evening everyone, welcome to today's UPI fraud simulation session.
18/03/26, 6:48 pm - Raju ji: Evening Pooja. Ready with the test dataset.
18/03/26, 6:52 pm - Pranab ji: Hello team, I have loaded the dummy transaction logs into the sandbox.
18/03/26, 6:56 pm - Pooja ji: Great, let us start with Case 402 involving a fake QR code scam.
18/03/26, 7:01 pm - Pooja R.: Customer reported receiving a payment request instead of receiving money.
18/03/26, 7:05 pm - Raju ji: Classic collect request fraud. Amount shown is Rs 15,000.
18/03/26, 7:10 pm - Pranab ji: The VPA linked to the scammer is testuser99@upi.
18/03/26, 7:14 pm - Pooja ji: Check if the bank server flagged the transaction auto-debit alert.
18/03/26, 7:18 pm - Pooja R.: The alert was generated at 6:30 pm but wasn't acted upon immediately.
18/03/26, 7:22 pm - Raju ji: We need to test the manual override protocol now.
18/03/26, 7:26 pm - Pranab ji: Attempting to freeze the beneficiary account in the test environment.
18/03/26, 7:30 pm - Pooja R.: Did the system prompt for dual approval?
18/03/26, 7:34 pm - Raju ji: Yes, sending approval request to Pranab ji's terminal.
18/03/26, 7:37 pm - Pranab ji: Received the alert. Calling fraud analyst line now.
18/03/26, 7:37 pm - Raju ji: Call connected, confirming security PIN reset.
18/03/26, 7:37 pm - Pooja R.: Wait, there is a secondary unauthorized transfer in the log.
18/03/26, 7:37 pm - Raju ji: It looks like an insider breach scenario introduced in the module.
18/03/26, 7:37 pm - Pranab ji: I see an unverified transaction record #8841.
18/03/26, 7:38 pm - Pooja R.: That record needs immediate isolation.
18/03/26, 7:38 pm - Raju ji: Pooja ji, what is the protocol for compromised logs?
18/03/26, 7:38 pm - Pooja ji: Pranab ji, delete the transfer record right now
18/03/26, 7:42 pm - Pranab ji: Record deleted from test database as instructed.
18/03/26, 7:48 pm - Pooja R.: Good response time. That concludes step 2 of the exercise.
18/03/26, 7:55 pm - Raju ji: Now reviewing the audit logs for evidence of deletion.
18/03/26, 8:05 pm - Pooja ji: Deletion was captured correctly in the secondary trace.
18/03/26, 8:15 pm - Pranab ji: Excellent, the dual-logging safeguard worked properly.
18/03/26, 8:25 pm - Pooja R.: Please compile the report summary for today's drill.
18/03/26, 8:35 pm - Raju ji: Summary submitted to the portal.
18/03/26, 8:45 pm - Pooja ji: Session closed. Thanks everyone for participating.
